The full look is one tap away. 41 */ 42 export const MAX_THUMB_PIECES = 3; 43 44 type Candidate = { category: string; imageUrl: string }; 45 46 /** One upper-body piece, the bottoms, the shoes — in that reading order. */ 47 const UPPER = ["Outerwear", "Tops"]; 48 49 /** 50 * Choose and position the cutouts for one day's cell. 51 * 52 * Order is fixed — upper body, bottoms, shoes — so a sparse look fills the 53 * template from the top rather than leaving a hole where its missing piece 54 * would have gone. 55 */ 56 export function thumbnailPieces(pieces: Candidate[]): DiaryPiece[] { 57 // A piece the storage layer could not sign is dropped here rather than 58 // rendered as , which React treats as an error. 59 const usable = pieces.filter((p) => Boolean(p.imageUrl)); 60 61 const upper = UPPER.map((c) => usable.find((p) => p.category === c)).find(Boolean); 62 const bottoms = usable.find((p) => p.category === "Bottoms"); 63 const shoes = usable.find((p) => p.category === "Shoes"); 64 65 const chosen = [upper, bottoms, shoes].filter((p): p is Candidate => Boolean(p)); 66 67 // A look made only of accessories has none of the three preferred slots, and 68 // an empty cell would read as "nothing logged" for a day that was logged. 69 if (chosen.length === 0) { 70 chosen.push(...usable.slice(0, MAX_THUMB_PIECES)); 71 } 72 73 const capped = chosen.slice(0, MAX_THUMB_PIECES); 74 return capped.map((p, i) => ({ imageUrl: p.imageUrl, slot: SLOT_ORDER[i] })); 75 } 76
